title: Dynamic Champion Shadow Daily v2
description: Unified schema for forward PIT collector output and shadow lifecycle evaluator input. Every field required by the lifecycle evaluator MUST be present; no field may be freely filled by the caller when a derivation rule exists.

strategy_id.description: Strategy identity — must match formal manifest

release_id.description: Release identity — must match formal manifest

formal_run_id.description: Formal run identifier this shadow day is bound to

formal_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the formal run manifest

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this observation was collected

authoritative_calendar_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the frozen authoritative trade calendar used

authoritative_trade_calendar_open.description: DERIVED: true when this date is an open SSE trading day per frozen calendar

same_day_complete_pit.description: DERIVED: true when data_date equals observed date AND all technical components captured

shadow_day_count_eligible.description: DERIVED: true when same_day_complete_pit AND formal PIT eligible AND replica verified

technical_pass.description: DERIVED: from component collection status + replica verification

execution_proxy_available.description: DERIVED: from execution proxy availability check

incremental_hard_block.description: DERIVED: true when a hard-block condition was detected

recovery_event_count.description: DERIVED: number of recovery events triggered this day

recovery_event_return.description: DERIVED: return of recovery events this day, or null if none

state_switch.description: DERIVED: true when market regime state changed this day

switch_source.description: DERIVED: source of state switch — only REAL_OBSERVED counts

reconciliation_errors.description: DERIVED: count of ledger reconciliation errors this day

cost_after_alpha.description: DERIVED: total cost after alpha for this day

completed_round_trips.description: DERIVED: number of completed round trips this day

input_evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 binding: formal_manifest_sha + component SHAs + observed_at

row_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the entire row (excluding row_sha256 itself), for chain integrity
